bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
compose=(docker compose -p deploy -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml)
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 22c930f364bcec223a0a3ddca9d04dbadf74d1bc4cffe4d08494ef8e1a4311b7
pg_before="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)"
ub_before="$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)"
test "$ub_before" != 0
read_pending(){
 docker exec -i "$1" node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import fs from 'node:fs';
import https from 'node:https';
const token=fs.readFileSync(process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE,'utf8').trim();
const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{
 const req=https.get('https://api.telegram.org/bot'+token+'/getWebhookInfo',{family:4,timeout:8000},res=>{
 let s='';res.on('data',c=>s+=c);res.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(s);resolve(j.ok&&!j.result.url?j.result.pending_update_count:null)}catch{resolve(null)}});
 });req.on('timeout',()=>req.destroy());req.on('error',()=>resolve(null));
});
if(!Number.isSafeInteger(result)||result<0)process.exit(2);
console.log(result);
JS
}
initial="$(read_pending deploy-gaybbs-1)"
echo "QUEUE_INITIAL=$initial"
if test "$initial" = 0; then echo QUEUE_DRAINED_WITH_NORMAL_BOT=PASS; exit 0; fi
probe=deploy-gaybbs-queue-probe-b847
if docker inspect "$probe" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo PROBE_NAME_OCCUPIED; exit 3; fi
# Instrument only method names and response codes; never log URLs, tokens,
# update bodies, chat IDs or message contents. The original app handles updates.
trace="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node -e 'const s=`import https from "node:https";import{syncBuiltinESMExports}from"node:module";const original=https.request;https.request=function(...args){const req=original.apply(this,args);const path=String(req.path||"");const m=/\\/(getUpdates|deleteWebhook|getMe|sendMessage|editMessageText|answerCallbackQuery)(?:\\?|$)/.exec(path);if(m){const name=m[1];console.log("POLL_TRACE",name,"request");req.once("response",res=>{console.log("POLL_TRACE",name,"response",res.statusCode);res.once("end",()=>console.log("POLL_TRACE",name,"end"));});req.once("error",e=>console.log("POLL_TRACE",name,"error",String(e.code||e.name).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g,"")));}return req;};syncBuiltinESMExports();`;process.stdout.write("data:text/javascript;base64,"+Buffer.from(s).toString("base64"))')"
restore(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if docker inspect "$probe" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$probe")" = true; then docker stop -t 90 "$probe" >/dev/null || true; fi
  if docker inspect "$probe" >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker rm "$probe" >/dev/null || true; fi
 fi
 "${compose[@]}" up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null || exit 91
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 92
 test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = "$pg_before" || exit 93
 test "$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)" = "$ub_before" || exit 94
 echo ORIGINAL_BOT_DB_USERBOT_RESTORED=PASS
 exit "$rc"
}
trap restore EXIT
"${compose[@]}" stop -t 30 gaybbs >/dev/null
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = false
"${compose[@]}" run --no-deps -d -T --name "$probe" --entrypoint node gaybbs --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --import "$trace" /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
 if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$probe")" != true; then echo PROBE_EXITED; break; fi
 n="$(read_pending "$probe" || echo unavailable)"
 echo "QUEUE_SAMPLE_$i=$n"
 if test "$n" = 0; then echo QUEUE_DRAINED_WITH_NORMAL_BOT=PASS; break; fi
 sleep 3
done
docker logs --tail 1000 "$probe" 2>&1 | python3 -c 'import re,sys,collections
s=sys.stdin.read()
for k,v in sorted(collections.Counter(re.findall(r"^POLL_TRACE ([a-zA-Z]+ (?:request|end|response [0-9]+|error [a-zA-Z0-9_]+))$",s,re.M)).items()):print("TRACE",k,v)
for k in ["GAYBBS_BOT_READY","GAYBBS_ERROR","GAYBBS_FATAL","POST_PUBLICATION_FAILED"]:print("LOG_COUNT",k,s.count(k))'
